layers.description: Gameplay tile identity such as grass, water, floor, wall.
0-100 terrain height used for shore, cliff, cave, and waterline rules.
Generated moisture used by grass, wetlands, crops, rivers, and decor.
Soil/crop quality, saved once the player modifies farmland.
Direction for river animation, fishing, and water sound.
Non-blocking flowers, reeds, shells, pebbles, mushrooms, foam, etc.
Interactable or blocking objects such as trees, ore nodes, furniture.
Gameplay zones for tavern, kitchen, field, cave, guest rooms, etc.
Snow, leaves, spring flowers, dry summer dust, wet rain overlay.
